" alt="Little Bloom birthday events poster with plaster unicorn, star and teddy figures, paint pots and party decorations"></div>

<canvas id="fx"></canvas>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var phrases=["Paint, Create, Bloom!","DIY Painting Kits","Birthday Events","Ages 3–6","Packed With Love","Small Hands, Big Imaginations","Party Favours","Creative Crafts"];
var html=phrases.map(function(p){return "<span>"+p+"</span><span>✦</span>"}).join("");
document.getElementById('strip1').innerHTML=html+html;

var themes=[["🦄","Unicorn Magic"],["🚀","Space Explorers"],["🦖","Dino Land"],["🧸","Teddy Picnic"],["👻","Spooky Cute"],["🐰","Bunny Garden"],["🏰","Fairy Castle"],["🌊","Under the Sea"],["🦁","Safari Friends"],["🚗","Little Racers"]];
var tw=document.getElementById('themesGrid');
themes.forEach(function(t){
  var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';
  b.textContent=t[0]+'  '+t[1];
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){burst(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/3,40);});
  tw.appendChild(b);
});

var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}})},{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){io.observe(el)});
setTimeout(function(){document.querySelectorAll('.reveal:not(.in)').forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in')});},3500);

var cv=document.getElementById('fx'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),parts=[],raf=null;
function size(){cv.width=innerWidth;cv.height=innerHeight} size(); addEventListener('resize',size);
var COLORS=['#ff6fa5','#ffe93d','#2fe84f','#2ee6c8','#6ab8ff','#b388ff','#ff9a3d'];
function burst(x,y,n){
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){parts.push({x:x,y:y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*13,vy:-Math.random()*12-3,g:.32+Math.random()*.12,s:5+Math.random()*8,c:COLORS[i%COLORS.length],r:Math.random()*Math.PI,vr:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,life:70+Math.random()*40,shape:Math.random()<.4?'circle':'rect'});}
  if(!raf)tick();
}
function tick(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
  parts=parts.filter(function(p){return p.life>0});
  parts.forEach(function(p){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=p.g;p.r+=p.vr;p.life--;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(p.r);ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.life/30);ctx.fillStyle=p.c;
    if(p.shape==='circle'){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,p.s/2,0,7);ctx.fill();}else{ctx.fillRect(-p.s/2,-p.s/2,p.s,p.s*.62);}ctx.restore();});
  raf=parts.length?requestAnimationFrame(tick):(ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height),null);
}
function popBalloons(n){
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='balloon';b.textContent='🎈';
    b.style.left=(8+Math.random()*84)+'vw';b.style.animationDuration=(3.4+Math.random()*2.4)+'s';
    document.body.appendChild(b);setTimeout(function(el){el.remove()},6500,b);
  }
}

var paintColors=[['Bubble Pink','#ff4d8d'],['Sunny Yellow','#ffc93c'],['Bloom Green','#58a82c'],['Sky Blue','#3a86ff'],['Grape Purple','#9b5de5'],['Peachy Orange','#ff8a3d'],['Aqua Teal','#00b8a9'],['Berry Red','#ef476f'],['Snow White','#ffffff']];
var pal=document.getElementById('palette'),current='#ff4d8d',painted=0;
var msg=document.getElementById('artMsg');
paintColors.forEach(function(c,i){
  var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='pot'+(i===0?' sel':'');
  b.style.background=c[1];b.title=c[0];b.setAttribute('aria-label','Paint colour '+c[0]);
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){document.querySelectorAll('.pot').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('sel')});b.classList.add('sel');current=c[1];msg.textContent=c[0]+' selected — now tap a shape!';});
  pal.appendChild(b);
});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-shape]').forEach(function(svg){
  function paint(){
    if(svg.querySelector('g')){svg.querySelectorAll('g circle').forEach(function(c){c.setAttribute('fill',current)});}
    else{var main=svg.querySelector('path');if(main)main.setAttribute('fill',current);}
    painted++;
    var r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    burst(r.left+r.width/2,r.top+window.scrollY,14);
    msg.textContent=['Beautiful!','What a little artist!','Gorgeous colours!','Tanzila would love that!'][painted%4];
  }
  svg.addEventListener('click',paint);
  svg.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();paint();}});
});
document.getElementById('celebrateBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  if(painted===0){msg.textContent='Paint a shape first, little artist!';return;}
  burst(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/2,120);popBalloons(4);
  msg.textContent='Masterpiece complete! Small hands, big imaginations!';
});
document.getElementById('resetArt').addEventListener('click',function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-shape]').forEach(function(svg){
    svg.querySelectorAll('path,g circle').forEach(function(el){if(el.getAttribute('stroke'))el.setAttribute('fill','#ffffff');});
  });
  painted=0;msg.textContent='Fresh canvas! Pick a colour pot to begin…';
});
})();
</script>

COLORS.concat([['Black','#333']]).forEach(function(c){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-col';bt.style.background=c[1];bt.title=c[0];bt.onclick=function(){col=c[1];stamp=null;popS()};st.querySelector('#dcols').appendChild(bt)});

GAMES.colormatch=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap the colour I say!');function round(){var c=R(COLORS);st.innerHTML='<p class="g-word">Tap: <span style="color:'+c[1]+'">'+c[0].toUpperCase()+'</span></p><div class="g-grid"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');shuffle(COLORS).forEach(function(x){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-col';bt.style.background=x[1];bt.style.width='88px';bt.style.height='88px';bt.onclick=function(){if(x[0]===c[0]){msg(b,'Yes! function popGame(b,inst,makeItem){var st=head(b,inst);st.innerHTML='<div class="catchbox"></div>';var box=st.querySelector('.catchbox');return box}
GAMES.balloonpop=function(b){var box=popGame(b,'Pop 10 balloons before they fly away! 🎈');var n=0;function spawn(){if(n>=10)return;var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='popitem';bt.textContent='🎈';bt.style.left=(5+Math.random()*85)+'%';bt.style.top='75%';box.appendChild(bt);var y=75;var id=every(function(){y-=1.6;bt.style.top=y+'%';if(y<-12){clearInterval(id);bt.remove()}},50);bt.onclick=function(){clearInterval(id);bt.textContent='💥';popS();n++;setScore(n);later(function(){bt.remove()},150);if(n>=10){msg(b,'You popped 10 balloons! 🎉');addStar(1)}else spawn()};later(spawn,600)}spawn();spawn()};
GAMES.bubblepop=function(b){var st=head(b,'Pop ONLY the colour bubbles I say!');function round(){var c=R(COLORS);st.innerHTML='<p class="g-word">Pop: '+c[0]+'</p><div class="catchbox"></div>';var box=st.querySelector('.catchbox');var popped=0;for(var i=0;i<14;i++){var x=R(COLORS);if(i<5)x=c;var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='popitem';bt.textContent='🫧';bt.style.color=x[1];bt.style.left=(4+Math.random()*86)+'%';bt.style.top=(5+Math.random()*75)+'%';bt.style.textShadow='0 0 12px '+x[1];bt.onclick=(function(col,el){return function(){if(col===c[0]){el.remove();popS();popped++;setScore(popped);if(popped>=5){msg(b,'Bubble star! ⭐');addStar(1);later(round,900)}}else{sad();msg(b,'Oops! GAMES.starcatcher=function(b){catchGame(b,'Move the basket ◀ ▶ to catch 8 stars!',false)};

function drop(){var good=isFruit?R(['🍎','🍓','🍌','🍇','🍊']):'⭐';var item=Math.random()<.25&&isFruit?'🥦':good;var el=document.createElement('div');el.className='faller';el.textContent=item;var x=8+Math.random()*84;el.style.left=x+'%';var y=-8;box.appendChild(el);var id=every(function(){y+=2.2;el.style.top=y+'%';if(y>82){clearInterval(id);el.remove();if(Math.abs(x-bx)<13){if(item==='🥦'){sad();msg(b,'Yucky broccoli! GAMES.whack=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap the flowers when they pop up! Play again!');return}var cm=R(empty);board[cm]='⭐';btns[cm].textContent='⭐';if(win('⭐')){over=true;msg(b,'Computer wins! Try again!');sad()}};btns.push(bt);g.appendChild(bt)})(i)}};
GAMES.simon=function(b){var st=head(b,'Watch the colours flash, then tap them in the same order!');var cols=[['#FF4757','Red'],['#3A86FF','Blue'],['#FFC93C','Yellow'],['#58CC7A','Green']];st.innerHTML='<div class="simon"></div><br><button class="go-again" id="sstart">Start ▶</button>';var g=st.querySelector('.simon');var pads=[],seq=[],idx=0,playing=false;
cols.forEach(function(c,i){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.style.background=c[0];bt.onclick=function(){if(playing)return;flash(i);if(i===seq[idx]){idx++;if(idx===seq.length){msg(b,'Amazing memory! ⭐');addStar(1);later(next,800)}}else{sad();msg(b,'Oops! Watch again!');idx=0;later(show,700)}};pads.push(bt);g.appendChild(bt)});
function flash(i){pads[i].classList.add('lit');tone(300+i*120,'triangle',.25);later(function(){pads[i].classList.remove('lit')},350)}
function show(){playing=true;idx=0;seq.forEach(function(v,i){later(function(){flash(v)},500*(i+1))});later(function(){playing=false;msg(b,'Your turn!')},500*(seq.length+1))}
function next(){seq.push(Math.floor(Math.random()*4));show()}
st.querySelector('#sstart').onclick=function(){seq=[];setScore(0);next();this.remove()}};
GAMES.oddone=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap the picture that is DIFFERENT!');function round(){var pairs=[['🍎','🍐'],['🐶','🐱'],['⭐','💗'],['🚗','✈️'],['🌸','🌻']];var p=R(pairs);var arr=Array(8).fill(p[0]);var odd=Math.floor(Math.random()*8);arr[odd]=p[1];st.innerHTML='<div class="g-grid"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');arr.forEach(function(e,i){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.textContent=e;bt.onclick=function(){if(i===odd){msg(b,'Eagle eyes! ⭐');addStar(1);later(round,800)}else{sad();msg(b,'That one is the same — look again!')}};g.appendChild(bt)})}round()};
GAMES.spotdiff=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap the 5 things in the RIGHT picture that are different!');var base=['☀️','🌳','🏠','🐶','🌸','🚗','☁️','🦋'];var diff=['🌙','🌴','🏰','🐱','🌻'];var found=0;st.innerHTML='<div class="diffscene"><div class="diffbox" id="dleft"></div><div class="diffbox" id="dright"></div></div><p class="g-word">Found: <span id="dfound">0</span> / 5</p>';
st.querySelector('#dleft').innerHTML=base.map(function(e){return '<span>'+e+'</span> '}).join('');
var right=base.slice();[0,2,3,4,7].forEach(function(pos,i){right[pos]=diff[i]});var rg=st.querySelector('#dright');right.forEach(function(e,i){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.textContent=e;bt.onclick=function(){if([0,2,3,4,7].indexOf(i)>-1&&!bt.dataset.done){bt.dataset.done=1;bt.style.background='#FFE066';bt.style.borderRadius='50%';found++;st.querySelector('#dfound').textContent=found;popS();if(found>=5){msg(b,'You found ALL 5! 🔍🏆');addStar(2)}}else if(!bt.dataset.done){sad()}};rg.appendChild(bt)})};
GAMES.countstars=function(b){var st=head(b,'Count the stars, then tap the right number!');function round(){var n=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*10);st.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:40px;line-height:1.4;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto">'+'⭐'.repeat(n)+'</div><div class="g-grid"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');shuffle([n,n+1,Math.max(1,n-1),n+2]).slice(0,4).forEach(function(v){if(v<1)v=2;var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.textContent=v;bt.onclick=function(){if(v===n){msg(b,'Yes! There are '+n+' stars! ⭐');addStar(1);later(round,900)}else{sad();msg(b,'Count slowly again!')}};g.appendChild(bt)})}round()};
GAMES.numberpop=function(b){popLettersNumbers(b,false)};
GAMES.alphapop=function(b){popLettersNumbers(b,true)};
function popLettersNumbers(b,isLetter){var st=head(b,isLetter?'Pop the LETTER I say!':'Pop the NUMBER I say!');function round(){var pool=isLetter?'ABCDEFGH':'123456789';var target=R(pool.split(''));st.innerHTML='<p class="g-word">Pop: '+target+'</p><div class="catchbox"></div>';var box=st.querySelector('.catchbox');var items=shuffle(pool.split(''));items.forEach(function(v,i){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='popitem';bt.textContent=v;bt.style.fontFamily='"Baloo 2"';bt.style.fontWeight='800';bt.style.background='#fff';bt.style.borderRadius='50%';bt.style.width='64px';bt.style.height='64px';bt.style.left=(5+(i%4)*24)+'%';bt.style.top=(8+Math.floor(i/4)*30)+'%';bt.onclick=function(){if(v===target){msg(b,'Popped '+target+'! ⭐');addStar(1);later(round,800)}else{sad();msg(b,'Find '+target+'!')}};box.appendChild(bt)})}round()}
GAMES.lettermatch=function(b){var st=head(b,'Big letter, find its SMALL letter!');function round(){var L=R('ABCDEFGHMNPST'.split(''));st.innerHTML='<div class="g-big">'+L+'</div><div class="g-grid"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');var opts=shuffle([L.toLowerCase(),R('bdfghkmn'.split('')),R('pqrstw'.split('')),R('acegij'.split(''))]);opts.forEach(function(v){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.textContent=v;bt.onclick=function(){if(v===L.toLowerCase()){msg(b,L+' matches '+v+'! ⭐');addStar(1);later(round,900)}else sad()};g.appendChild(bt)})}round()};
GAMES.wordbuilder=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap the letters in order to build the word!');var words=[['CAT','🐱'],['SUN','☀️'],['BEE','🐝'],['DOG','🐶'],['EGG','🥚'],['BUS','🚌']];function round(){var w=R(words);var idx=0;st.innerHTML='<div class="g-big">'+w[1]+'</div><p class="g-word" id="wprog">'+w[0].split('').map(function(){return ' _ '}).join('')+'</p><div class="g-grid"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');shuffle(w[0].split('').concat([R('XYZ'.split(''))])).forEach(function(v){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.textContent=v;bt.onclick=function(){if(v===w[0][idx]){bt.classList.add('good');bt.disabled=true;idx++;popS();st.querySelector('#wprog').textContent=w[0].slice(0,idx).split('').join(' ')+' '+' _ '.repeat(w[0].length-idx);if(idx===w[0].length){msg(b,'You built '+w[0]+'! 🏆');addStar(2);later(round,1100)}}else{sad();msg(b,'Next letter is '+w[0][idx])}};g.appendChild(bt)})}round()};
GAMES.animalsound=function(b){var st=head(b,'Who makes this sound? Tap the animal! 🔊');var data=[['Moo!','🐮'],['Roar!','🦁'],['Quack!','🦆'],['Meow!','🐱'],['Woof!','🐶'],['Oink!','🐷']];function round(){var t=R(data);st.innerHTML='<p class="g-word">"'+t[0]+'"</p><div class="g-grid"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');shuffle(data).forEach(function(x){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.textContent=x[1];bt.onclick=function(){if(x[1]===t[1]){msg(b,'Yes! '+t[1]+' says '+t[0]+' ⭐');tone(400,'triangle',.3);addStar(1);later(round,900)}else sad()};g.appendChild(bt)})}round()};
GAMES.rainbowsort=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap a ball, then tap its SAME colour pot!');var pots=[['#FF4757','Red'],['#3A86FF','Blue'],['#FFC93C','Yellow'],['#58CC7A','Green']];var balls=shuffle(pots.concat(pots));var sel=null,sorted=0;st.innerHTML='<p class="g-word">Balls left: <span id="rleft">'+balls.length+'</span></p><div class="g-grid" id="rballs"></div><p class="g-inst" style="margin-top:16px">Pots 👇</p><div class="g-grid" id="rpots"></div>';var bg=st.querySelector('#rballs');balls.forEach(function(p){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-col';bt.style.background=p[0];bt.onclick=function(){sel={c:p[0],el:bt};bg.querySelectorAll('.g-col').forEach(function(x){x.style.outline='none'});bt.style.outline='5px solid #4A2C6B';popS()};bg.appendChild(bt)});
pots.forEach(function(p){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.style.background=p[0];bt.style.color='#fff';bt.textContent=p[1];bt.onclick=function(){if(sel&&sel.c===p[0]){sel.el.remove();sel=null;sorted++;st.querySelector('#rleft').textContent=balls.length-sorted;popS();if(sorted>=balls.length){msg(b,'Rainbow sorted! 🌈🏆');addStar(2)}}else if(sel){sad();msg(b,'That ball goes in '+pots.filter(function(x){return x[0]===sel.c})[0][1]+' pot!')}};st.querySelector('#rpots').appendChild(bt)})};
GAMES.pattern=function(b){var st=head(b,'What comes NEXT in the pattern?');function round(){var seqs=[[['⭐','💗','⭐','💗'],'⭐'],[['🌸','🌸','☀️','🌸','🌸'],'☀️'],[['🔴','🔵','🟡','🔴','🔵'],'🟡'],[['🐶','🐱','🐶','🐱'],'🐶']];var s=R(seqs);st.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:44px">'+s[0].join(' ')+' ❓</div><div class="g-grid" style="margin-top:16px"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('.g-grid');shuffle(['⭐','💗','☀️','🌸','🟡','🐶',s[1]]).slice(0,4).concat([]).forEach(function(v){});var opts=shuffle(Array.from(new Set([s[1],'🍓','🚗','🌙'])));opts.forEach(function(v){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.textContent=v;bt.onclick=function(){if(v===s[1]){msg(b,'Pattern genius! ⭐');addStar(1);later(round,900)}else sad()};g.appendChild(bt)})}round()};
GAMES.maze=function(b){var st=head(b,'Use the arrows to guide the bee 🐝 to the flower 🌸!');var walls={1:1,2:1,7:1,12:1,13:1,17:1};var pos=0,goal=24;st.innerHTML='<div class="mazegrid" id="mz"></div><div class="arrowrow"><button class="arrowbtn" data-d="-5">⬆</button></div><div class="arrowrow"><button class="arrowbtn" data-d="-1">⬅</button><button class="arrowbtn" data-d="1">➡</button></div><div class="arrowrow"><button class="arrowbtn" data-d="5">⬇</button></div>';var g=st.querySelector('#mz');function draw(){g.innerHTML='';for(var i=0;i<25;i++){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='mazecell'+(walls[i]?' wall':'');d.textContent=i===pos?'🐝':(i===goal?'🌸':(walls[i]?'':'·'));g.appendChild(d)}}draw();st.querySelectorAll('[data-d]').forEach(function(bt){bt.onclick=function(){var np=pos+ +bt.dataset.d;if(np<0||np>=25||walls[np]){sad();return}if(+bt.dataset.d===1&&pos%5===4)return;if(+bt.dataset.d===-1&&pos%5===0)return;pos=np;popS();draw();if(pos===goal){msg(b,'Bee found the flower! 🐝🌸🏆');addStar(2)}}})};
GAMES.puzzle=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap a piece next to the empty space to slide it. Put 1–8 in order!');var tiles=[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,'',8];st.innerHTML='<div class="puzgrid" id="pz"></div>';var g=st.querySelector('#pz');function draw(){g.innerHTML='';tiles.forEach(function(v,i){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className=v===''?'empty':'';bt.textContent=v===''? '':['1️⃣','2️⃣','3️⃣','4️⃣','5️⃣','6️⃣','7️⃣','8️⃣'][v-1]||v;bt.onclick=function(){var e=tiles.indexOf('');var adj=[i-1,i+1,i-3,i+3];if(adj.indexOf(e)>-1&&Math.abs((i%3)-(e%3))+(Math.abs(Math.floor(i/3)-Math.floor(e/3)))===1){tiles[e]=v;tiles[i]='';popS();draw();if(tiles.join(',')==='1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,'){msg(b,'Puzzle complete! 🧩🏆');addStar(2)}}};g.appendChild(bt)})}draw()};
GAMES.teddy=function(b){var st=head(b,'Tap hats and clothes to dress Teddy! Tap Done when Teddy looks fab!');st.innerHTML='<div class="g-big" id="ted">🧸</div><p class="g-word" id="toutfit">Teddy is ready to dress!</p><div class="g-grid" id="tclothes"></div><div style="margin-top:14px"><button class="go-again" id="tdone" style="background:#58CC7A">Done! ⭐</button></div>';var outfits=[['🎩','Top Hat'],['👑','Crown'],['🎓','Grad Cap'],['👕','Blue Top'],['👗','Dress'],['🧣','Scarf'],['🕶️','Cool Shades'],['🎀','Bow']];var chosen=[];var g=st.querySelector('#tclothes');outfits.forEach(function(o){var bt=document.createElement('button');bt.className='g-opt';bt.innerHTML=o[0]+'<span style="font-size:14px;display:block">'+o[1]+'</span>';bt.onclick=function(){if(chosen.indexOf(o[0])<0)chosen.push(o[0]);st.querySelector('#ted').textContent=o[0]+' 🧸';st.querySelector('#toutfit').textContent='Teddy wears: '+chosen.join(' ');popS()};g.appendChild(bt)});st.querySelector('#tdone').onclick=function(){if(chosen.length){msg(b,'Teddy looks FABULOUS! 🧸✨');addStar(1)}else msg(b,'Pick a hat or top first!')}};
var TITLES={draw:'Paint & Draw',colormatch:'Colour Match',shapematch:'Shape Match',memory:'Memory Match',balloonpop:'Balloon Pop',bubblepop:'Bubble Pop',starcatcher:'Star Catcher',fruitcatch:'Fruit Catch',whack:'Whack-a-Flower',tictactoe:'Tic-Tac-Toe',simon:'Simon Colours',oddone:'Odd One Out',spotdiff:'Spot the Difference',countstars:'Counting Stars',numberpop:'Number Pop',lettermatch:'Letter Match',alphapop:'Alphabet Pop',wordbuilder:'Word Builder',animalsound:'Animal Sounds',rainbowsort:'Rainbow Sort',pattern:'Pattern Play',maze:'Maze Runner',puzzle:'Puzzle Slider',teddy:'Dress the Teddy'};
function openGame(id){curId=id;curTitle=TITLES[id]||'Game';score=0;updStars();document.getElementById('goTitle').textContent=curTitle;var ov=document.getElementById('gameOverlay');ov.classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';clearT();ac();GAMES[id](document.getElementById('gameBody'))}
function closeGame(){clearT();document.getElementById('gameOverlay').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow='';document.getElementById('gameBody').innerHTML=''}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-game]').forEach(function(bt){bt.addEventListener('click',function(){openGame(bt.dataset.game)})});
document.getElementById('goClose').addEventListener('click',closeGame);
document.getElementById('goAgain').addEventListener('click',function(){if(curId)openGame(curId)});
updStars();
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
